customers_change_pct.label: Customer visits change vs last month

avg_ticket_change_pct.label: Average bill change vs last month

payables_overdue_ratio.label: Overdue payables share of food purchases

profit_report_mismatch.label: Reported profit does not match revenue minus expenses

monthly_customers_mismatch.label: Monthly customers do not match daily customers

staff_exceeds_employees.label: Staff on duty exceeds total employees

discount_pct.label: Discounts given (% of sales)
discount_pct.question: Roughly what share of your sales goes out as discounts and offers? Type a number (e.g. 8) or a word (low / medium / high).

wastage_pct.label: Food wastage (% of food bought)
wastage_pct.question: Roughly what percentage of the food you buy gets wasted? Type a number (e.g. 15) or a word (low / medium / high).

overdue_installments.label: Overdue loan instalments
overdue_installments.question: How many loan instalments are currently overdue? Type a number (0 if none).

labour_hours_month.label: Labour hours worked this month
labour_hours_month.question: About how many total staff working hours were there this month? Type a number if you know it.

cancellations_up.label: Order cancellations increasing
cancellations_up.question: Have order cancellations (by customers or by you) increased recently?

delivery_declining.label: Delivery orders declining
delivery_declining.question: Have your delivery or takeaway orders gone down in the last two months?

discount_dependence.label: Sales depend on discounts
discount_dependence.question: When you stop a discount or offer, do your sales drop sharply?

supplier_prices_up.label: Supplier prices increased
supplier_prices_up.question: Have your suppliers increased their prices over the last three months?

cash_volatile.label: Cash balance swings widely
cash_volatile.question: Does your cash balance swing a lot from week to week (for example, very low just before payday)?

unsold_food.label: Large unsold prepared food at closing
unsold_food.question: At closing time, is a large amount of prepared food often left unsold?

expiry_before_use.label: Perishables expire before use
expiry_before_use.question: Do vegetables, meat, dairy or other perishables often expire before you use them?

overstocking.label: Buying more than needed
overstocking.question: Do you often buy more stock than you need (for example, because of bulk-buy discounts)?

prep_same_weekday_weekend.label: Same preparation on all days
prep_same_weekday_weekend.question: Do you prepare roughly the same amount of food on weekdays as on weekends?

supplier_delays.label: Supplier deliveries often late
supplier_delays.question: Do supplier deliveries often arrive late?

low_margin_bestsellers.label: Best-sellers have low margins
low_margin_bestsellers.question: Are your best-selling dishes the ones with the lowest profit per plate?

overtime_increasing.label: Overtime increasing
overtime_increasing.question: Has the money you pay for overtime increased recently?

absenteeism.label: Absenteeism affecting service
absenteeism.question: Do staff absences (especially on busy days) disturb your service?

staff_turnover.label: Frequent staff turnover
staff_turnover.question: Do staff leave frequently, so you keep hiring and training new people?

idle_time.label: Staff idle on quiet days
idle_time.question: On quiet weekdays, are staff often standing idle with little to do?

prep_bottleneck.label: Kitchen/prep bottleneck delays orders
prep_bottleneck.question: During rush hours, are orders delayed because the kitchen or prep area cannot keep up?

obligations_concentrated.label: Payments concentrated in one period
obligations_concentrated.question: Are most of your big payments (rent, salaries, loans, suppliers) due in the same week?

supplier_credit_dependence.label: Increasing reliance on supplier credit
supplier_credit_dependence.question: Are you relying more and more on supplier credit to keep the restaurant running?

expansion_financed_by_debt.label: Expansion financed by borrowing
expansion_financed_by_debt.question: Did you recently expand (new branch, renovation, equipment) using borrowed money?

orders_trend.label: Daily orders trend
orders_trend.question: Compared with 3 months ago, are your daily orders:

repeat_trend.label: Repeat customers trend
repeat_trend.question: Compared with 3 months ago, are regular (repeat) customers:

stockouts.label: How often items run out
stockouts.question: How often do popular items run out while customers are still ordering?
